core: T cell immunological synapse, adhesion and polarity
qualifier: T cell surface and activation signatures
name: T cell synapse formation, adhesion and surface signature
rationale: All members concern T lymphocyte adhesion, polarization, raft localization and synapse formation; unlike the confusables (Vav1/CORO1A-DEF6 second-messenger signaling) it carries T cell surface and leukocyte activation/migration signatures rather than downstream signaling.

name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: All three members describe degradation of the aromatic amino acids tyrosine and phenylalanine, whereas confusables cover threonine, glycine/glyoxylate or generic amino acid metabolism.

core: Bacterial adhesion and entry into host cells
name: Gram-positive bacterial adhesion and invasion of epithelial cells
rationale: Members cover bacterial attachment to epithelia, InlA-mediated Listeria entry, actin-based motility and regulation of bacterial entry, distinguishing it from confusables about Mtb immune evasion, toxins or antimicrobial peptides.

core: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin signaling controlling body growth
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
rationale: Members are GH/prolactin/leptin JAK-STAT receptor signaling, IGF regulation, organism growth and thyroid hormone generation/transport/signaling; the thyroid arm separates it from the IL-6-cytokine confusable and the GH/prolactin arm from steroid and somatostatin confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity establishment in embryonic epithelium
rationale: All members concern establishing planar polarity and asymmetric PCP protein localization, while confusables cover the downstream tissue outcomes (convergent extension, neural plate, inner ear morphogenesis).

qualifier: nuclear receptor and vitamin D regulation
name: SREBP cholesterol homeostasis with nuclear receptor/vitamin D regulation
rationale: Members combine SREBP target activation and cholesterol homeostasis with nuclear receptor transcription, receptor SUMOylation and vitamin D/vitamin metabolism regulation, the latter absent from the ATF6, ChREBP and fatty acid confusables.

core: Cajal body small RNA trafficking and modification
name: Cajal body RNA modification and telomerase-mediated telomere extension
rationale: Members cover scaRNA/telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies, sn/rRNA modification, telomerase holoenzyme assembly and telomere lengthening; the telomerase extension arm separates it from the snoRNA modification confusable and the RNA modification arm from the telomere protection confusable.

core: B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: naive/memory B cell signatures, positive regulation
name: B cell activation and proliferation with naive/memory B signatures
rationale: All members describe positive regulation of B cell activation, proliferation, differentiation and BCR signaling plus B cell and naive/memory B signatures, unlike confusables focused on germinal centre/Tfh co-stimulation or negative BCR regulation.

core: MET receptor tyrosine kinase downstream signaling
name: MET receptor downstream signaling and drug inhibition
rationale: Every member is MET activation of a downstream effector (PI3K/AKT, STAT3, RAP1/RAC1, PTPN11, RAS) or its drug inhibition, whereas confusables cover generic PI3K/AKT, IGF1R and ALK/LTK signaling.

qualifier: sex steroids and CYP enzyme defects
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis including CYP enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, gluco/mineralocorticoid, androgen and estrogen synthesis and the CYP deficiency diseases, while confusables concern vitamin D/retinoid CYPs or aldosterone/cortisol secretion without sex steroid synthesis.

core: Interleukin-4 and interleukin-13 production and signaling
name: Interleukin-4 and interleukin-13 production and signaling
rationale: All members concern IL-4/IL-13 production or receptor signaling, while confusables describe Th2 differentiation, IL-5 and eosinophil/mast cell responses.

name: Glycogen synthesis, breakdown and glycogen storage diseases
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis, glycogenolysis, glycophagy, glucose-6-phosphate handling and the inherited glycogen storage disorders, which the glycolysis/fructose/gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

core: Striated muscle development, growth and adaptation
qualifier: skeletal myogenesis and satellite cell regeneration
name: Striated muscle myogenesis, regeneration, growth and contraction
rationale: Members span myoblast proliferation/fusion, satellite cell regeneration, sarcomere assembly, contraction, hypertrophy/atrophy and cardiomyocyte growth, distinguishing it from smooth muscle, heart morphogenesis and calcineurin/phosphatase confusables.

name: Glucose glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control
rationale: Members cover hexokinase-initiated glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate metabolism, lactate fermentation and its fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation, unlike confusables centred on glycogen, glucagon/PKA or pentose-phosphate regulation.

qualifier: inhibitory KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: Inhibitory KIR/MHC class Ib control of NK cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK receptor clusters (KIR), MHC class Ib presentation, protection from and negative regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity and tolerance, distinguishing it from confusables about T cell costimulation and positive NK cytotoxicity.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell efferocytosis
rationale: Members cover microglial differentiation, activation, migration and cytotoxicity together with apoptotic cell recognition, phosphatidylserine exposure and engulfment, unlike confusables about amyloid-beta clearance, scavenger receptors or DAP12.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification, redox homeostasis and MTF1 induction
rationale: Members are ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, HMOX1 and restraint of oxidoreductase/H2O2 metabolism; the MTF1 arm and oxidoreductase restraint separate it from the closest ROS confusable, and the ROS core from nitrosative and metal-response confusables.

name: Organic and amino acid metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members are broad (obsolete) amino/organic acid metabolism terms plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, the conjugation arm being absent from threonine, glycine and proline confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members cover recruitment of NuMA and centrosome proteins, AURKA-TPX2 activation, astral microtubules and spindle localization/orientation, distinguishing it from interphase centrosome/cilium confusables and broad mitotic progression confusables.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and hydrogen peroxide turnover
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and the regulation of H2O2 synthesis/catabolism, superoxide removal and oxygen detection, which separate it from nitrosative-stress, MTF1 and ferroptosis confusables.

name: Protein oligomerization, membrane insertion and magnesium transport
rationale: Members are generic homo/hetero-oligomerization terms, multi-pass ER membrane insertion, NLRP1 inflammasome assembly and magnesium transport/response (weakly coherent, likely shared genes); the oligomerization and NLRP1 members distinguish it from inositol and tight-junction confusables.

name: Microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and migration
rationale: All members concern microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and lysosome organization, without the apoptotic-cell clearance or amyloid-beta handling of the confusables.

name: Dectin C-type lectin antifungal recognition and IL-23 induction
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/Dectin-2 family signaling, responses to fungal molecules and IL-23 production, distinguishing it from IL-17, IL-1 family and Th1 cytokine confusables.

core: RNA polymerase II pausing and early elongation
name: RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation, including HIV Tat
rationale: Members describe early elongation complex formation, promoter-proximal pausing and recovery, largely in HIV Tat-dependent transcription, unlike confusables covering initiation, promoter escape or termination.

core: Choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and transport
name: Choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin metabolism with FMO oxidation
rationale: Members cover synthesis, catabolism and transport of choline, carnitine, thiamine and riboflavin plus FMO-mediated oxidation (trimethylaminuria), distinguishing it from cobalamin/folate, sulfur amino acid and fatty acid oxidation confusables.
